title: The Moral Turing Test: Evaluating Human-LLM Alignment in Moral Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in human agreement with moral judgments based on the evaluator's belief of whether the text was generated by a human or an AI model, specifically noting when users disagree with content they suspect is AI-generated.

Evaluating human alignment and actual agreement rates with AI-generated moral justifications versus human-generated ones, particularly in complex, high-stakes personal moral scenarios where AI output was favored.
Analyzing the cognitive dissonance and tendency of participants to unconsciously attribute highly agreeable or favored moral judgments to their own group (humans) rather than the outgroup (machines).
